tool.title: Is this clip worth a render?
tool.summary: A 6-question scorer that tells you whether an idea deserves one of your 50 monthly renders, so the cap stops being a problem.
tool.intro: The front end gives you 50 renders a month. Answer six quick questions about a clip idea before you render it. Ideas that score high get rendered; low scorers get fixed first or dropped, so your renders go to clips that have a real chance.

questions.q: Does the idea fit into one clear point under 60 seconds?
Can the first 3 seconds stop a scroller (question, bold claim, surprising visual)?
Does your audience search for or ask about this topic?
Do you have the rights to the footage, music and text you'll use?
Will you post it within the next 7 days?
Have you already rendered a similar clip this month?

options.label: Yes, but this angle is different

bands.title: Render it
bands.advice: This idea is focused, has a hook and you'll post it soon. Use a render on it, then save the settings as a template so the next one is faster.

bands.title: Fix it first
bands.advice: There's something here, but it isn't ready. Tighten it to one point, write a stronger opening line, and check the rights to anything you didn't make. Score it again before rendering.

bands.title: Save your render
bands.advice: Skip this one for now. Put it in an ideas list and come back when you have a clear point, a hook and a posting date.

plan.title: Your first 7 days with ClipForge AI
plan.summary: A day-by-day plan from setup to your first week of posted clips, with one small goal per day.
plan.intro: One short session a day. By day 7 you'll have a brand kit, a reusable template and a week of clips posted, plus a simple way to see what worked.

days.title: Set up your brand kit
tasks: Log in and open the brand kit.
Add your logo, colours and fonts.
Pick the 1 or 2 platforms you'll post on first.
days.result: Every video you make from now on looks like yours.

days.title: Turn one blog post into a video
tasks: Pick an article that already does well.
Run it through blog-to-video.
Trim it to under 60 seconds and preview it.

days.title: Fix captions and voice
tasks: Read the auto captions word by word and fix mistakes.
Try two or three voices and keep the clearest one.
Keep background music low so the voice is easy to hear.
days.result: A finished first clip you're happy to post.

days.title: Plan a week of clips
tasks: Write down 7 clip ideas.
Run each one through the scorer above.
Keep the ideas that score 75 or more.
days.result: A short list of ideas worth your renders.

days.title: Batch-render and save a template
tasks: Render your top 3 ideas in one sitting.
Save your best settings as a template.
Note how many renders you've used this month.
days.result: Three clips ready and a template for next time.

days.title: Post your clips
tasks: Post one clip on each platform you picked.
Write a short caption that ends with a question.
Note the time you posted each one.

days.title: Check what worked
tasks: After a day, check views and watch time for each clip.
Write down what the best clip did differently.
Plan next week's ideas around it.
days.result: A simple weekly routine you can repeat.
